author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
description: Tactical combat states, grid movement modifiers, and aura states from LeTBS

states.name: Paralyze
states.description: The unit is paralyzed by kinetic or electrical shock, skipping their active turn.

states.name: Intimidating Aura
states.description: Vanguard presence radiating kinetic threat. Adjacent enemies suffer -15% ATK; wielder gains 70% counter-attack chance.

states.name: Heavy Strike
states.description: Target is staggered by a crushing blow, reducing grid movement points by 3.

states.name: Focused
states.description: Forces enemy combatants to focus offensive actions upon the vanguard.

states.name: Light Steps
states.description: Grants agility and unencumbered stride, increasing grid movement budget by +1 point.

states.name: Ghost Arrow
states.description: An ethereal spectral arrow anchors the target's shadow, reducing movement points by 1.

states.name: Burning
states.description: Target or grid tile is enveloped in flames. Damages occupants and spreads to adjacent flammable tiles.
